findings.reason: without a constructed failure the node's gate cannot show that its timing instrument distinguishes a passing fit from a slow one, which is the whole measure §4 exists to deliver.
findings.text: §4 clause (2) fails on a comparison of a measured wall against a measured reference, but the section declares no negative control: nothing in it requires a known-slow run to exceed the ceiling, and nothing pins the cache state of the reference forward solve, so a harness that measures the cached reference warm against a reconstruction that excludes its own compile can report a ratio at or below ten whatever the implementation does

findings.reason: the section's only pass/fail clause cannot be evaluated until its denominator is fixed as per-slice or total, and whichever the author picks changes the measured verdict for an unchanged implementation.
findings.text: §4 clause (2) compares a per-slice wall against "the warm forward solve at the same shape and width", and that denominator's units are not stated: a batched width-16 forward solve has a total wall and a per-slice wall, and the two readings make the ceiling 160 forward-solve slices or 10 respectively, a factor of the batch width apart; clause (1) meanwhile requires the record to report the forward solves per reconstruction, the very count the ceiling is arithmetic over, so the node measures a number and then has no defined threshold to read it against

findings.reason: the cited evidence exists and supports the claim, so only the href needs the missing `plans/` segment and no semantic content of the plan changes.
findings.text: s0 supports its premise ("failed 10 of 12 EFIT parity metrics", which the cited plan's own recorded verdict does confirm as "ten of twelve registered metrics") with a link whose path is wrong, and a reader following it reaches no document, which is the one way a correct citation still fails

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the s0 citation `<a href="/nova/spine-efit-parity">` does not resolve, because the document it names lives at `docs/plans/spine-efit-parity.html` and the nova mount serves `docs/` at `/nova/`, so the href resolves to `/nova/spine-efit-parity.html` rather than the existing `/nova/plans/spine-efit-parity.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4 states a hard ceiling but no clause constructs a measurement that must exceed it, so nothing shows the timing harness can detect a violation; the hardening of clause (2) makes the ceiling falsifiable in principle without showing the instrument that reads it is falsifiable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the record the plan names is `docs/evidence/archive/inverse-equilibrium-baseline-landed.html`, in-repo and durable, and §4's measurements are written there rather than to a session path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §4 and the declarations meta carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags into symbols, and the only identifiers present (`H200`, `MAST`, `IMAS`, `efit`) are domain names; the sprint value sits in the plan's own metadata where plan state belongs.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §4's clause (2) divides a per-slice wall by "the warm forward solve at the same shape and width", whose units are undefined: read as the batch's total wall the ceiling is 160 forward-solve slices at width 16, read as that solve's per-slice wall it is 10, so the node cannot know whether its own reported forward-solves-per-reconstruction fits under a ceiling the plan leaves a factor of the batch width wide.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 delivers one quantity, the cost of one reconstruction, reported across three batch widths.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the demotion of `s2` to `deferred` is carried consistently through all four surfaces that name it (the `plan-section-declarations` meta, the s2 section record's `data-status`, the body's "Deferred until the decisions ... are locked" paragraph, and the contract table's "§1 and two decisions"), and the two decisions it waits on now carry `data-sections="s2"`, so the earlier declaration that a deferred section was implementable is resolved.
